decision: Filter Hz 1.1.0 adds the Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74 release from rytm2_mods v1.2, the same port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0008-filter-hz, under GPL-2.0-only with attribution.

files.note: Merged with filter-hz/filter-hz.s (7de4714b…7a8d, the OS 1.73 source already imported at 698b859); the two differ only in their .include line.

transformations: mod.json's 1.74 port site (0x400a86b4, 8 stock bytes, jmp filter_hz_gate) became an address, length and SHA-256 guard in build.json's 1.74 release, with defsym OS174.

src/filter-hz.s chooses include/ar2-1.74.inc under .ifdef OS174 and include/ar2-1.73.inc otherwise, and its site comment names both addresses. Result sha256: 7f04cc85036679ca0b29d54f6fd90f31ffea47f42d0e81efefbeb2bfed775b64.
include/ar2-1.73.inc stays at 698b859; v1.2 adds three symbol names to it that Filter Hz does not use.
